task_description: Build a comprehensive Bhutan Travel Experience Library as a Next.js application with 8 core modules: Destinations (by Dzongkhag), Tours/Packages (Premium/Luxury tiers), Tour Calculator (itemized cost computation), Vehicles, Hotels, Food, Experiences, and a Package Customizer (matchmaking tool). All items include USD pricing for total cost calculation.

verification.summary: npm run build exits 0 with 42 static pages generated. npm test passes all 37 tests (calculator and customizer). Semantic review issues addressed: tours/experiences multiplied by persons, customizer includes SDF/visa with groupSize multiplication, candlelight dinner pricing fixed, moderate budget has price ceiling, vehicle selection is capacity-based, hotel selection prefers location match.
